reviews.comment: Not sure why he took a capstone class. Unlike other professors who allow you to choose your own projects, Dangert wanted to use students for his work in auto drive. Inaccessible outside class and rude. When asking for help, he won't be able to figure anything and leave it up to you, and punish you heavily for it later. Not even exaggerating, avoid.
